content.text: Miss Trotter confesses her love for Chris Calton in her drawing-room, then arranges his departure and later vanishes from the Summit House and a foreign Spa. The narrative shifts to Scotland: Old Mortality restores Covenanter graves. At a wappen-schaw, Henry Morton wins the popinjay and meets Balfour of Burley at the Wallace Inn. Morton shelters Burley in a hayloft at Milnwood, but soldiers arrest him there. Cuddie and Mause move to Milnwood, while Edith sends Goose Gibbie from Tillietudlem to Charnwood for help. Edith visits Morton in his turret closet. Claverhouse arrives at Tillietudlem, initially orders Morton’s execution, but Lord Evandale secures his reprieve; Morton is taken to the courtyard with other prisoners.
